summary: Short hover and focus micro-copy that explains a control.
purpose: Clarify icon-only or dense controls. Keep the title short; do not hide required instructions only in a tooltip.

anatomy.description: The short explanation on hover or focus.

whenToUse: Adding a short hint on dense UI.

do: Keep titles under about one short sentence.
Ensure the trigger is keyboard focusable.
dont: Put critical legal copy only in a tooltip.

keyboard: Shows on focus as well as hover.
aria: Uses the trigger's accessible name; title is supplemental.
accessibility.contrast: Bubble text against bubble fill holds at least 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus: Trigger shows visible focus; tooltip follows.

examples.title: Icon hint
examples.code: <Tooltip title="Log a new mess"><Button aria-label="Log a new mess">+</Button></Tooltip>

related.whenToChoose: Dialog for longer explanations that need a decision.
